COMMON QUESTIONS

Know what to expect before you book.

The strategy call is a practical conversation about your market and whether the service fits your business.

Who is this service designed for?

U.S.-based individual real estate agents and small teams that want a seller-focused acquisition channel beyond referrals and can respond quickly to new inquiries.

How much should I plan to spend on ads?

We recommend starting with at least $1,500 per month in Meta ad spend, paid directly to Meta. Benzify’s management fee is separate.

What does Benzify manage?

We manage campaign strategy, seller-focused messaging, video direction, editing, ad creative, campaign setup, geographic targeting, lead forms, retargeting, tracking, reporting, testing, and optimization.

How does the video process work?

We give you prompts and clear recording guidance. You record simple raw footage, usually on your phone, and Benzify handles the editing, graphics, copy, and campaign-ready variations.

Do I need professional equipment or editing experience?

No. Clear, authentic footage is the goal. We guide the recording and take care of post-production.

Who follows up with the leads?

Your team contacts and nurtures incoming leads. Managed follow-up and appointment setting are not included, so the service works best when you can respond promptly.

Are leads or appointments guaranteed?

No. Campaign results vary by market, offer, budget, creative, competition, and follow-up. Benzify provides the strategy, campaign execution, testing, and optimization—not a guaranteed outcome.

What happens during the strategy call?

In 30 minutes, we review your market, current acquisition approach, advertising readiness, budget, and possible campaign direction. The call is free and there is no obligation.
